name: THE CITY BAKERY Ginza
nameJa: ザ・シティ ベーカリー 銀座
address: 5-2-1 Ginza, Tokyu Plaza Ginza B2F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A New York-style bakery cafe in the basement of Tokyu Plaza Ginza with free Ginza Wi-Fi and power outlets at the back-left seats, so it works well for laptop work over breakfast or coffee.

name: THE CITY BAKERY Atre Shinagawa
nameJa: ザ・シティ ベーカリー アトレ品川
description: A branch of the New York bakery chain inside Atre Shinagawa with free Wi-Fi and about 55 seats right by the station, but one work-cafe guide reports no power outlets, so it suits a short stay rather than long laptop work.

name: DEAN & DELUCA Cafe Tokyo Midtown Hibiya
nameJa: ディーン&デルーカ カフェ 東京ミッドタウン日比谷
address: 1-1-4 Yurakucho, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya 1F, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A DEAN & DELUCA bakery-deli cafe in Tokyo Midtown Hibiya with free Wi-Fi and outlets at the 14 counter seats, quiet for solo laptop work on weekday afternoons.

name: DEAN & DELUCA Cafe Marunouchi
nameJa: ディーン&デルーカ カフェ 丸の内
address: 1-4-5 Marunouchi, Mitsubishi UFJ Trust Bank Head Office Building 1F, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A bright, high-ceilinged DEAN & DELUCA cafe near Tokyo Station with free Wi-Fi and power outlets, comfortable for laptop work or a light meeting.

name: DEAN & DELUCA Cafe Shibuya Stream
nameJa: ディーン&デルーカ カフェ 渋谷ストリーム
description: A large DEAN & DELUCA cafe connected to Shibuya Station with fast free Wi-Fi, but outlets reach only about one in five seats, so the window counter is the best spot for working.

name: DEAN & DELUCA Cafe Tokyo College of Music Nakameguro-Daikanyama Campus
nameJa: ディーン&デルーカ カフェ 東京音楽大学 中目黒・代官山キャンパス
address: 1-9-1 Kamimeguro, Tokyo College of Music Nakameguro-Daikanyama Campus 3F, Meguro-ku, Tokyo
description: A spacious DEAN & DELUCA cafe inside the Tokyo College of Music campus with its own free Wi-Fi and power outlets at the window counter seats, open in the daytime for laptop work.

name: Sarutahiko Coffee Marunouchi
nameJa: 猿田彦珈琲 丸の内
address: 2-1-1 Marunouchi, Meiji Yasuda Seimei Building B2F, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A Sarutahiko coffee shop with an in-house bakery counter in a Marunouchi food hall, offering shared Wi-Fi and some power outlets for daytime work.

name: 365 nichi to COFFEE Tamagawa Takashimaya
address: Tamagawa, Tamagawa Takashimaya S.C., Setagaya-ku, Tokyo
description: A cafe run by the popular 365日 (365 Days) bakery inside Tamagawa Takashimaya with free Wi-Fi and outlets at the big wooden tables, comfortable for longer laptop sessions.

name: &COFFEE MAISON KAYSER Tamachi
description: A French bakery cafe (Maison Kayser) directly linked to the msb Tamachi mall with free Wi-Fi and power outlets across its 28 calm seats, one minute from Tamachi Station.

name: &COFFEE MAISON KAYSER Otemachi One
address: 1-2-1 Otemachi, Otemachi One Avenue B1F, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
description: A small Maison Kayser bakery cafe in the Otemachi One basement with free Wi-Fi and 31 seats, open weekday daytime, though power outlet availability is not confirmed.

name: bricolage bread & co.
nameJa: ブリコラージュ ブレッド アンド カンパニー
address: 6-15-1 Roppongi, Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Terrace 1F, Minato-ku, Tokyo
description: A bakery cafe in Roppongi Hills run with a Michelin restaurant and Norwegian roaster Fuglen, with power outlets at its sofa and terrace seats, though Wi-Fi is not confirmed.

name: Le Pain Quotidien Shibakoen
nameJa: ル・パン・コティディアン 芝公園店
address: Shibakoen, Minato-ku, Tokyo (near Tokyo Prince Hotel)
businessHours: Morning to evening (hours vary; opens around 7:00-8:00)
description: A big, airy Le Pain Quotidien bakery cafe near Onarimon with free Wi-Fi and lots of terrace seating but no power outlets, so it is better for a short visit.

name: Saint Marc Cafe Ebisu West Exit
nameJa: サンマルクカフェ 恵比寿西口店
description: A Saint Marc Cafe (a bakery cafe chain known for its choco cro, a chocolate-filled croissant) near Ebisu's west exit with free Wi-Fi, outlets at some of its 107 seats, and long hours until late.

name: Saint Marc Cafe Ebisu East Exit
nameJa: サンマルクカフェ 恵比寿東口店
description: A bright, glass-walled Saint Marc Cafe by Ebisu station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at some of its 91 seats, open from early morning until late.
